levels.surface: محمد بن يوسف بن ثابت بن قيس بن شماس

notes: Dash glosses («قال أحمد حدثنا ابن وهب»، «وقال ابن السرح») name the same teacher; left out as glosses
The second group is Ibn Salih's variant name for Yusuf (a remark naming a different transmitter), marked variant
After the Prophet's words, «عن ثابت بن قيس ثم أخذ ترابا» starts a second action with no isnad of its own; whether it is a second saying is unsettled (rule 11)
«قال أبو داود... وهو الصواب» is commentary, not a link
